import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt
def build(p):
    X=np.column_stack([1/t, np.log(1+p[0]*t)*A**2, np.exp(-p[1]*t)*t**p[2]])
    return X
p=np.array([0.2152,-0.1783,-1.3101])
def R(p):
    X=build(p); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]; return X@c-y
r=least_squares(R,p,bounds=([1e-3,-3,-4],[10,3,4]))
X=build(r.x); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]; res=y-X@c
print('params',r.x,c, 'nmse',np.sum(res**2)/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2))
bA=np.digitize(A,np.linspace(0.2,4,9))
print('A-bins mean res:',[ (round(float(A[bA==b].mean()),2), round(float(res[bA==b].mean()),3), round(float(res[bA==b].std()),3)) for b in np.unique(bA)])
bt=np.digitize(t,np.linspace(0.5,10,9))
print('t-bins mean res:',[ (round(float(t[bt==b].mean()),2), round(float(res[bt==b].mean()),3), round(float(res[bt==b].std()),3)) for b in np.unique(bt)])
# does residual correlate with A-basis times t-basis?
for nm,f in {'A':A,'A2':A**2,'logA':np.log(A),'expA':np.exp(A/2),'expmA':np.exp(-A),'1/A':1/A}.items():
    Z=np.column_stack([X,f*np.exp(-r.x[1]*t)*t**r.x[2]]) 
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,y,rcond=None)[0]
    print(nm, float(np.sum((y-Z@cc)**2)/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2)))
